question: Based on our customer pizza order information, summarize the total quantity of each ingredient used in the pizzas we delivered. Output the name and quantity for each ingredient.
sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT order_id 
    FROM pizza_clean_runner_orders 
    WHERE cancellation IS NULL OR cancellation = ''
),
order_pizzas AS (
    SELECT pco.order_id, pco.pizza_id
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders pco
    JOIN delivered_orders d ON pco.order_id = d.order_id
),
pizza_topping_ids AS (
    SELECT op.order_id, op.pizza_id, TRIM(SPLIT_PART(pr.toppings, ',', s.n)) AS topping_id_str
    FROM order_pizzas op
    JOIN pizza_recipes pr ON op.pizza_id = pr.pizza_id
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(generate_series(1, 12)) AS s(n)
),
valid_toppings AS (
    SELECT order_id, pizza_id, topping_id_str
    FROM pizza_topping_ids
    WHERE TRIM(topping_id_str) != '' AND TRY_CAST(TRIM(topping_id_str) AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT pt.topping_name, COUNT(*) AS quantity
FROM valid_toppings vt
JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON TRY_CAST(vt.topping_id_str AS INTEGER) = pt.topping_id
GROUP BY pt.topping_name
ORDER BY pt.topping_name
